name: TOOLTOP T256 thermal camera (0bda:5840)

connection.notes: Plugged straight into a MacBook Air USB-C port it fails to enumerate (USB transaction errors, "persistent enumeration failures"); works through a USB 2.0 hub.

notes: Sold as TOOLTOP T256. Reports itself as "Generic USB Camera" (Realtek chip). 256x384 carries the camera's own picture over raw temperatures; 256x192 is the picture only. Sends black frames for about 4 s after it starts streaming. About 6 s after the stream starts, all readings drop by roughly 5 °C at once (seen on every start), presumably the camera calibrating itself; they are stable after that.
